correctness.rationale: Write G_t=F_(6t)/8. Its exact recurrence G_(t+2)=18G_(t+1)−G_t and generating-function binomial expansion show G_(t+2^r)−G_t≡2^r modulo 2^(r+1); lifting proves every 8-multiple occurs. J_t=L_(6t+3)/4=G_t+G_(t+1) similarly covers all odd residues at every 2-power precision. The four six-step sequence residues give F_even mod8={0,2} and L_even mod8={2,4}. Two-summand exclusion and explicit lifts for residue types 2,4,6 follow, and adding fixed F or Lucas classes covers all even residues in three terms. Independently computed complete periods and both modular sumsets for m=3,...,8; unbounded claim rests on the lifting proof, not the bounded census.
residual_risks: No global fixed-three-summand integer representation follows.
